title: Community Based Obesity Prevention Among Black Women
brief_summary: This study will evaluate the efficacy of a behavioral intervention, designed to prevent weight gain among overweight and low obese (25-34.9 kg/m2) Black women (aged 25-44), compared to usual care.
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* African-American
* Female
* Ages 25-44
* BMI between 25-34.9 kg/m2
* Patients with at least 1 visit in the previous 24 months to a participating Community Health Center

Exclusion Criteria:

* Not currently pregnant
* Not given birth within the past 12 months
* No history of myocardial infarction or stroke in last 2 years
